statement: Retrospective cost reporting separates fresh from inherited attempts, counts verifier rejection fingerprints once while retaining event counts, and distinguishes planned child lineage from evidence-backed rejection respins.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Preserve the cost command and tally API while making fresh work the primary cost; inherited history and raw duplicate rejection events remain visible but never inflate fresh cost or unique rejection rounds.
A parent link alone is planned lineage, not proof of duplicated ceremony; rejection-respin classification requires explicit or strong verifier-fix evidence.
